gaps.explanation: No transfer line is in detail (schedule 0). The governmental funds statement p10 prints, by fund: Transfers from Other Funds General Fund 122,281, Street Fund 173,087; Transfers to Other Funds General Fund (355), Community Development Fund (85,457); p11 Adjustments column (85,812) / 85,812 and Total 209,556 / 0. Added the four gross fund-column transfer lines (gross per fund, as detail records transfers). After the fix the governmental transfers-in detail is 122,281 + 173,087 = 295,368 vs statement Total 209,556: the remaining -85,812 is only the Adjustments column netting the governmental interfund transfers (355 + 85,457 = 85,812) = different basis, not an error. The governmental transfers-out lines (355 + 85,457 = 85,812 vs statement Total 0) are the same netting. Also added the business-type 'Transfers' cells of the proprietary statement p15 (Electric Fund (150,000), Water Fund (59,556); total (209,556) = the governmental net transfers in), so the utility fund columns are complete; they are business-type and do not count in this governmental row.

gaps.explanation: The business-type detail lines are the four Business-Type Activities rows of the Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - Total Primary Government (p19, cash budgetary basis): Electric 850,176 + Solid Waste 106,118 + Sewer 184,682 + Water 201,805 = 1,342,781 (detail indexes 25-28). They are the same funds' spending on another basis, while the proprietary fund columns the statement uses are not in detail (and the revenue side is now taken from those columns). Statement: Total Operating Expenses 1,101,671 (p14) + Interest Expense 11,323 (p15) = 1,112,994. Fix: remove the four budget lines and add one line per printed non-zero cell of the proprietary statement fund columns: Electric 83,120 + 403,693 + 28,540 + 106,703 + 32,729 = 654,785 + interest 1,120; Water 88,379 + 4,945 + 2,274 + 31,323 + 6,146 = 133,067; Sewer 74,093 + 2,460 + 4,658 + 27,889 + 97,406 = 206,506 + interest 10,203; Sanitation 103,782 + 3,531 = 107,313. Added 654,785 + 1,120 + 133,067 + 206,506 + 10,203 + 107,313 = 1,112,994. Check: 1,342,781 + 1,112,994 - 1,342,781 = 1,112,994 = statement (gap 0).
